title: Russian Missiles and 149 Drones Hit Ukraine; Kyiv's Northern Bridge Damaged
detail: Overnight Nov 6-7 air defence downed or suppressed four missiles and 149 drones; the Kyiv region was the main target. Ukrinform reports missiles struck the Northern Bridge in Kyiv, damaging the roadway, trolleybus line and a power line. Single-outlet detail on the bridge.
